verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed, vendor-defined automatic steps, such as filing Form SS-4 for the EIN, filing 83(b) elections, sequencing signatures and issuing shares. None of these are user-defined rules that trigger actions on events, so they are adjacent behavior and earn no credit. missing for 10: any documented user-configurable rule or trigger engine, event-driven actions defined by the user, and webhooks or automation APIs for Atlas events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
